changelog: Adds a progress bar that shows the stage, the percent, and the time left, and a schedule section that links to the scheduled task. Makes exports with user watch state much faster: a library of 49,500 items now exports in 9 seconds instead of 48. Adds a performance test suite, and publishes the plugin under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
description: Export a readable inventory manifest of Jellyfin libraries, media files, metadata provider IDs, media streams, and optional user watch state.
name: Library Inventory Exporter
overview: Export Jellyfin library inventory to CSV and JSON.
